record.question: To which country does the winner of the 2013 Nobel Prize for Literature, Alice Munro belong?
record.explanation: The Nobel biographical record gives Munro's birthplace and award-time residence as Canada. This answers nationality at the 2013 award, not a claim about present life status. Historical exam context: 2015-01 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed.
